deck.name: ASL Alphabet
deck.description: American Sign Language fingerspelling — all 26 letters of the alphabet.

cards.label: A
cards.desc: Closed fist, thumb rests against the side

cards.label: B
cards.desc: Flat open hand, four fingers together pointing up, thumb folded across palm

cards.label: C
cards.desc: Curved hand forming a C shape

cards.label: D
cards.desc: Index finger points up, other fingers curve to touch thumb forming a D

cards.label: E
cards.desc: All fingers bent downward, thumb tucked under

cards.label: F
cards.desc: Index finger touches thumb forming a ring; middle, ring, and pinky point up

cards.label: G
cards.desc: Index finger and thumb point horizontally to the side

cards.label: H
cards.desc: Index and middle fingers point horizontally to the side, together

cards.label: I
cards.desc: Pinky finger points up, all others closed in a fist

cards.label: J
cards.desc: Pinky up like I, then trace a J shape in the air

cards.label: K
cards.desc: Index points up, middle finger extended out, thumb between them

cards.label: L
cards.desc: Index finger points up, thumb extends out — forms an L shape

cards.label: M
cards.desc: Three fingers (index, middle, ring) folded over the thumb

cards.label: N
cards.desc: Two fingers (index and middle) folded over the thumb

cards.label: O
cards.desc: All fingers and thumb curve to form a round O shape

cards.label: P
cards.desc: Like K but rotated so fingers point downward

cards.label: Q
cards.desc: Like G but rotated so fingers point downward

cards.label: R
cards.desc: Index and middle fingers crossed and pointing up

cards.label: S
cards.desc: Closed fist with thumb draped over the fingers

cards.label: T
cards.desc: Thumb inserted up between index and middle fingers

cards.label: U
cards.desc: Index and middle fingers point up together, side by side

cards.label: V
cards.desc: Index and middle fingers spread in a V / peace sign

cards.label: W
cards.desc: Index, middle, and ring fingers spread apart, pointing up

cards.label: X
cards.desc: Index finger hooked / bent forward like a hook

cards.label: Y
cards.desc: Thumb and pinky extended outward, middle three fingers closed

cards.label: Z
cards.desc: Index finger extended, traces a Z shape in the air
